projects.title: PairCheck - Image-Text Mismatch Detection
projects.description: Built an image-caption mismatch-detection pipeline using frozen CLIP embeddings and a trainable PyTorch classification head. Created COCO datasets with image-level splits and semantic hard negatives, used balanced minibatches and validation-based model selection, and evaluated an OpenCLIP ViT-B/32 baseline on SugarCrepe at 76.55% pairwise accuracy.

projects.title: LLM Agent Trace Analyzer
projects.description: Designed a trace-analysis workflow for an AI test-generation agent to uncover agent failures and enable root-cause analysis.

projects.title: SaliencyMix Replication
projects.description: Implemented core components of SaliencyMix, a saliency-based image-augmentation method, along with ResNet-18, ResNet-50, and ResNet-101 in PyTorch. Built saliency-map generation and image-region mixing for classification workflows.

projects.title: DeObfus Email
projects.description: Built a cross-browser extension that converts obfuscated email text into clean, copy-ready addresses. Implemented rule-based parsing for varied masking formats and handled Firefox/Chromium API and permission differences.

projects.title: HF ML App Analysis
projects.description: Collected and filtered applications built on top-downloaded Hugging Face text-classification and text-generation models. Extracted code-size metrics with Lizard and analyzed implementation-size and maintainability trends using Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib.
